title: cline: legacy ui_messages.json entries
description: Whole UI-message array for the legacy cline editor task surface. Not interchangeable with API conversation history. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

ts.description: Source numeric timestamp; validate unit with actual captured version.

type.description: UI event discriminator, commonly say or ask.

say.description: Say subtype, not a speaker role by itself.

ask.description: Ask subtype, not necessarily a completed human exchange.

text.description: UI text; may itself contain serialized structured content.

items.description: Image reference or encoded string; do not assume plain text.
